attributes.title: Path

lesson.concept: A drawn path can explain order and direction
lesson.why: The ring and spark have separate drawing transitions. Normalized path progress reveals the SVG geometry over time, while the curve and duration decide the character of the stroke.
lesson.experiment: Compare Slow signature and Electric sketch. Pause attention on where the stroke begins and whether the spark leads or follows the ring.
lesson.pitfall: Animating a path's visual appearance without preserving its final static shape can make reduced-motion output unreadable.
lesson.combine: Combine with build-order to start a stroke with or after a named beat.
